verdict_reason: The spec correctly proves the animals frontend delegates address creation to INS: it splits the original single test into environment-gated cases using existing skip helpers, uses the shared PartyPickerPage locators (role-based, semantic), keeps the button-absence assertion so a regression from link to button is still caught, and verifies the handshake href carries the journey-type; the sibling addresses-add-handshake.spec.ts covers the full URL and click-through.
